_source: Manually curated from https://untappd.com/blog's 'New Badge: X' posts - these are Untappd's own time-limited promotional badges, never in the permanent badges.untappd.com catalog (badge_beer_categories.json/badge_venue_categories.json), so they have to be read and re-catalogued by hand whenever a new one is announced. Checked live 2026-11-17 - entries are ACTIVE-or-UPCOMING as of that date (activeUntil >= today). The dedicated 'Untappd Check-In Challenge: Week 3' post (part of the ongoing Season 1 series already flagged in special_badges_pending_review.json) revealed computable criteria this check - 'check in any cider' - so its own entry was added below; Week 1's badge ('check in any drink') stays uncomputable and Weeks 4-10 remain unrevealed, per the pending-review note. No other new 'New Badge' posts were found since the prior 2026-11-16 check (Bar Fly, Amaro Day, Champagne Day, Mezcal Day, Gin & Tonic Day, Scream-Worthy Hard Cider, Liqueur Day, Pumpkin Beer Season, Barrel-Aged Beer Day, Untappd 16th Anniversary, International Stout Day are all already-handled posts from earlier checks - either previously added-then-expired-and-pruned, flagged pending review, or found already-moot), and no existing entries needed pruning (the list was already empty). New posts whose criteria this schema can't compute (brewery-specific, venue-location, or otherwise ambiguous) are logged in special_badges_pending_review.json instead of guessed here. Re-check the blog periodically (no feed/API for this - it's a real page read each time) and prune entries whose activeUntil has passed, same way this list was built.

special_badges.note: Check in any one (1) cider in the window to unlock this week's Check-In Challenge badge. Post's key line: 'This week, check in any cider to unlock the Week 3 Untappd Check-In Challenge badge and earn your entry', and names styles across the umbrella (dry, sweet, fruited, hopped, rose, barrel-aged). Confirmed live against the beer/top_rated style dropdown that every current cider leaf is shaped 'Cider - X' (Dry, Sweet, Hopped, Rose, Other Fruit, Traditional/Apfelwein, Perry/Poire, Ice, Graff, Applewine, Basque, Herbed/Spiced, Keeved/Cidre Bouche, Other) with no leaf named bare 'Cider', so the bare substring matcher 'Cider' (per _split_style_matchers' documented umbrella-entry convention) correctly covers all of them. No dedicated badge-artwork image found on the post (only the shared Season 1 header/OG image, reused across weekly posts), so no 'icon' field.
